{{Top|leg}}
An '''Environmental Converter''' was a device that could be installed aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that allowed the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] to alter the vessel's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] to provide comfort for differing [[Alien/Legends|alien]] physiologies. The environment change could be applied throughout the ship, or in a single cabin or cargo hold.
